headline: District Prepares for New School Year with Staffing, Facility, and Policy Updates
summary: The board approved personnel, donations, school wellness policies, 2026-2027 board policies reflecting the state's 66% attendance requirement, a graduation stoles/cords policy, a policy prohibiting student smart glasses and wearable recording devices bell to bell, and science textbooks. It awarded six base bids for the bleachers and press boxes project and denied combination Bid G.
attendance: All board members were present for the meeting with Stacy Stepp attending via phone call.
publicComment: There were no public comments and no one appeared before the board.

personnel.note: Hires include 8 substitutes (6 substitute teachers, a cafeteria substitute and a substitute bus driver), 2 ATSI tutors, teachers, coaching assignments, a middle school athletic director and a welding instructor; the 2025-2026 substitute teacher list was also approved (not counted). other = 1 leave request and 1 National Board supplement; transfers = 1 employee transfer reported in the superintendent's report.

policy.item: Approved 2026-2027 School Wellness Policies for Belmont, Burnsville, IES, IMS, TCHS and Tishomingo.
Approved policy changes reflecting the state law change in attendance requirement from 63% to 66% of the school day, along with School Board Policies for 2026/2027.
Approved the 2026/2027 Child Nutrition Complaint Policy.

Approved a graduation stoles/cords policy: only regalia distributed by an officially recognized school club or honor society; new regalia must be submitted to the principal by Dec. 15 and decided by the board at its January meeting.
Adopted a policy prohibiting student possession and use of smart glasses and wearable recording technology bell to bell, including class transitions, lunch and school transportation.

superintendent: Superintendent Christie Holly discussed the changes to the attendance policy that went into effect July 1, 2026.
Holly updated the board on district maintenance and reported no teacher or student attendance data due to summer break and no StopIt or Google reports this month.
The superintendent, directors and principals will attend the MASS Summer Conference in Biloxi in July.
New teacher training is July 23 at the Career & Technical Center, the annual budget hearing is July 21 at 6:00 p.m., and opening professional development is July 27 at TCHS.
A special called board meeting by phone is set for July 30 at 8:00 a.m. to vote on the budget; the first day for students is July 31.
otherActions: Denied Base Bid G (combination bid), 3-D Construction Company MS, LLC, $1,433,721
Approved denial of enrollment of two students due to unpaid tuition obligations from 2025-2026
Approved the pillars, vision and mission drafted by the Strategic Planning Committee, after an update from Board President Jessica Seaton
Authorized the annual transfer of district funds to school athletic funds
Fixed asset deletions for July 2026 approved
1 student transfer approved; another taken to executive session
Next regular meeting set for Aug. 10, 2026
